reason: app-design sections 1+5 own it end to end: DTCG format, Style Dictionary, token-adherence and scale-adherence as deterministic gate checks. Nothing left.
app-design section 4 verbatim, including the Partial state most sources omit (Scott Hurff's UI Stack).
app-design section 7 is a 7-step ordered review that stops at first failure.

frontend-design is Anthropic-authored and ALREADY INSTALLED on this box (verified at /root/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/claude-plugins-official/...). app-design 2/3 covers derivation and the slop list. A third would be waste.
frontend-design's writing section already carries the load-bearing rules: verb consistency across a flow, name-by-what-the-user-controls, errors do not apologize, an empty screen is an invitation.
Scout could not name what a baseline gets wrong -- it groups nav sections sensibly unprompted. Rejected by the scout on its own gate, which is the behaviour we want.

Owl-Listener/designer-skills ships 108 units of one-design-law-per-skill (hicks-law, law-of-closure, ...). Recall knowledge a capable model reproduces unprompted -- exactly the shape the kappa=-0.129 calibration warned about.

majiayu000/claude-skill-registry is a registry MIRROR, not a practitioner repo. ux-principles is a textbook transcription of Nielsen's 10; ux-user-flow turned out to be game-state routing for a single-page game, mis-described. Per LESSONS: an index, not a source.

A baseline writes breakpoints competently. The checkable part that IS missed -- SC 1.4.10 reflow at 320px, SC 1.4.4 text at 200% -- belongs inside accessibility-conformance-audit, not a unit of its own.

agent-harness-construction already covers the action space, granularity rules, observation shape (status/summary/next_actions/artifacts), the error-recovery contract, and names 'too many tools with overlapping semantics' as an anti-pattern. A new unit would fail gate 1 and collide on trigger with a unit that already has evals.

agent-surface-security-audit explicitly covers MCP configs, remote MCP URLs, prompt-injection vectors in doc bodies, over-permissive allowlists and supply-chain pointers, emitting PASS/SANDBOX/REJECT. Scio's untrusted-text-boundary owns the render-boundary/scan-at-sink side. A new unit would sit on top of both.

Writing idiomatic Python/TypeScript/Rust/Go is the baseline's STRONGEST ground -- the purest case of the kappa=-0.129 finding. The scout could not name a failure a competent baseline reliably makes that a SKILL.md would fix, and rejected it on its own gate. The two adjacent jobs that ARE real are already owned: matching an existing repo's implicit conventions is style-inheritance; not guessing a dependency's actual behaviour is source-grounded-implementation.

The 62-skill data-analysis cluster around ab-test-design is mostly persona- and tool-shaped (data-storyteller, pandas-power-user, excel-lookup-formulas, jupyter-workflow-master) -- libraries, not methods, per LESSONS.

majiayu000/claude-skill-registry: read in full. Welded to Prisma, and its core is a table of the four isolation levels plus a decision tree 'financial -> Serializable' -- exactly the recital a baseline already produces. Registry-shaped source at yield 0.00 per LESSONS.
